title: Simple Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 3 pounds boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs
⅜ cup (or 6 tablespoons) apple cider vinegar or red wine vinegar
1 tablespoon (or 3 teaspoons) Italian seasoning or Herbs de Provence
instructions: Whisk together all the wet ingredients and dry spices in a bowl.
Place the chicken and the marinade in a large resealable bag or bowl. Press out excess air, seal, and let it chill in the fridge for 30 minutes.
To Bake: 375°F for 15 minutes (or until juices run clear).
To Bake: 375°F for 15 minutes (or until juices run clear).
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before cutting to keep it juicy.
